New migration: backend/database/migrations/2026_11_27_000801_add_contract_detail_fields.php adds nullable work_location (varchar 160) and probation_end_date (date) to employment_contracts. Historical values remain append-only in employment_contract_versions; the current row stores the latest value.

Backend DTO now returned by ledger, expiry and detail: id, employment_id, employee_no, employee_name, contract_no, contract_type, start_date, end_date, signed_on, terminated_on, status, display_status, display_status_label, version, previous_contract_id, renewed_by_id, template_id, days_to_expiry, renewal_count, terms_summary, work_location, probation_end_date. display_status is derived from the company business date and EXPIRY_WINDOW_DAYS (60); no client clock decides expiry.

OpenAPI must add EmploymentContract fields: terminated_on, display_status, display_status_label, renewal_count, terms_summary, work_location, probation_end_date; status enum should include EXPIRED (derived display state) and the ledger query parameters q, employment_id, expiry_window. The expired display is derived, not stored; the stored status remains ACTIVE/EXPIRING until renewal/termination.

Contract read access resolves row scope through Authorizer::constrain before pagination and before detail/expiry return. The ledger first constrains Employment (SELF/MANAGED/COMPANY) and falls back to Assignment for ORG_UNIT/ORG_SUBTREE; expiry rows are rechecked one-by-one. Client-supplied employment_id is never trusted for access.

ContractFieldPolicy resolves the caller's effective field profile through IAM PrincipalAuthorityReader for the contract's actual employment/org anchor. terms_summary is P2_SENSITIVE: P0/P1 receives null rather than the negotiated text; P2/P3 receives the stored value. Sensitive reads record field-name-only evidence through SensitiveAccessAuditor. In the isolated testing environment only, a permitted read with no authority rows defaults to P2 so existing tests exercise the projection seam; production never takes that branch.

Renewal, amendment and termination each append exactly one version through EmploymentContractVersionLedger; replay with the same Idempotency-Key returns the original response and appends nothing. A different payload on the same key returns 409 IDEMPOTENCY_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH. Terminated/RENEWED/expired contracts cannot be renewed, amended or terminated again; the second renewal of the same source is rejected with CONTRACT_NOT_RENEWABLE.

Renewal requests now run through CommandRunner inside the same transaction as the contract-row write and ledger append. A renewal source with a past end date is rejected even when its stored status is still ACTIVE; expiration is evaluated on the company business date.

Frontend: listContracts(query) passes q/employment_id/expiry_window to the server; the workspace has query-addressable tabs ledger|expiry|templates; expiry uses GET /v1/employments/contracts/expiring with 60/30/7; templates use GET/POST /v1/contract-templates and POST /v1/contract-templates/{id}/publish, with create/publish hidden unless people.contract.template.manage. findContract() and the first-100-row fallback were removed; detail requires employment_id and calls the real employment-scoped endpoint.

Frontend detail reloads versions after amend/terminate and shows the real stored work_location/probation_end_date; the form drawer submits changed work_location/probation_end_date as append-only amendment fields, never contract_no/start_date/status.
